content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lincoln

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—typically a bachelor's degree plus three years of project experience, or equivalent alternatives—before applying. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you assess whether your background meets these requirements.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all sessions synchronously from your Lincoln location on a flexible schedule designed for working professionals. This formal instruction covers all PMI exam domains and fulfills the contact-hour requirement mandated by the Project Management Institute.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training hours, submit your formal application directly to PMI, including proof of your education and project experience. Pay the associated exam fee through PMI's portal. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on documentation requirements and the application process to ensure a smooth submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice exams, study materials, and instructor review sessions, to build confidence. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in Lincoln or nearby. Granite PM Academy's ongoing support helps you tackle the comprehensive exam with clarity.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll hold the PMP® credential for three years. Maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or other PMI-approved activities. Plan your PDU strategy early so renewal remains straightforward and your credential stays active throughout your career.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
